prompt: In a vibrant city park rendered in a polished 3D animated film still style, a young boy in a red hoodie stands center foreground holding a bright blue frisbee. To his left, a golden retriever with fluffy fur jumps eagerly toward the disc, its paws extended mid-air. On the right, an elderly woman in a yellow cardigan sits on a wooden bench, smiling warmly at the pair. Next to her, a small terrier in a pink sweater rests its chin on her knee. In the immediate foreground, a discarded ice cream cone lies on the grass near a scattered picnic blanket. Behind the boy, a teenage girl in denim overalls leans against a large oak tree, pointing toward the sky. A colorful kite is tangled in the branches above her head. To the far left, a man in a green tracksuit pushes a stroller containing a sleeping baby wrapped in white wool. A squirrel perches on the back of the bench, looking curiously at the terrier. The background features stylized skyscrapers under a soft, glowing sunset that casts long, dramatic shadows across the manicured lawn, enhancing the cheerful and dynamic atmosphere of the scene.
